labels.failure: same window terminal close return<0 and MAE<=-3
labels.urgent: At current state: exact v2 FAST_WINNER_now (first bar HIGH>=1 and common-end MFE>=3) OR (delay=0 and exact v1 original path_class=IMMEDIATE_WINNER).
labels.viable: current executable OPEN to original opportunity+60 common-end MFE>=3

architecture.preprocessing: Exact feature-manifest; train medians, explicit missing indicators, identity scaling. Binary scores are leaf weighted target means.
architecture.reason: A single shared shallow tree captures limited PIT context/state interactions that a static linear value comparison and context-free events missed; depth4 caps16 leaves. No model comparison. Three joint binary-target regressions yield local empirical scores, not calibrated probabilities.
architecture.reproducibility: Pinned versions and seed, saved tree/scaler/medians. Verify every node weighted moments, globally best eligible split impurity, leaf predictions and deterministic artifact inference. No research-data refit in tests/CI.
architecture.teacherSeparation: Future path only in TRAIN label builder and evaluator; no best entry/max future utility search; no learned WAIT advantage. Three heads jointly fit in one estimator.fit call.
architecture.training: Complete common60 TRAIN episodes only. All valid states at delay0,5,10,15, regardless subsequent policy reachability; each episode total sample_weight1 divided equally across states. Missing labels excluded, never0.

notes: Pullback alone never BUY. State evidence computed from completed bars only; may include current completed bar as support.
Route C is both WAIT transitions and later urgency/continuation/cap BUY. Route shares report terminal A/B/C/D and initial WAIT membership separately; not disjoint memberships.
Short WAIT is structurally available, no forced route quotas; zero WAIT or zero delayed BUY yields structural failure, no rescue.
Each opportunity one terminal decision; no resurrection. INITIAL/DIP share exact policy.
Missing price reference/required prefix/execution OPEN expires. Optional feature absence uses TRAIN imputation plus indicators.
At t, all bars end<=t; execute scheduled regular bar starting t OPEN after decision, never same completed signal LOW/CLOSE. OHLC ordering UNKNOWN_INTRABAR_ORDER.
No cross original morning/afternoon boundary. No future execution bar HIGH/LOW/CLOSE fed to decision.
priority: A at delay0: urgent>=.25 OR (viable>=.40 AND failure<.50) ->BUY_NOW
B delay>0: any earlier/current completed post-op close<0 AND (newLowStopped AND closeDeteriorationStopped OR priorHighReclaim OR momentumTurn) AND viable>=.20 AND failure<.50 ->BUY
C delay>0: urgent>=.25 OR (continuation AND viable>=.20 AND failure<.50) ->BUY
If delay<15 and next5 stays strictly inside original segment ->C WAIT_ONE_STEP
At cap/boundary-last-decision: viable>=.20 AND failure<.50 ->C BUY, else D EXPIRE

economicGates: Economic evaluable >=90% of common baseline; mean net delta>=.05pp, PF nonworse, p05 nonworse; both sources mean delta>=0; >=3/4 blocks net delta>=0; TRAIN-top3 exclusion delta>0.

entryGates.chronological: At least3/4 subblocks commonN>=20, +3/+5 preservation>=.80 where denominator exists, price improvement mean>=0; no subgroup thresholds/rules.
entryGates.cohorts: INITIAL and DIP each complete n>=30, entry coverage>=.60, +3/+5 preservation>=.85, strict30 entered-paired p05 no worse by more than.25pp.
entryGates.concentration: Exclude TRAIN-frequency top3 symbols (tie symbol ascending); same full overall entry gates excluding minimum sample / pullback cohort nesting. No blacklist.
entryGates.pullback: PULLBACK+DEEP_PULLBACK combined n>=10, paired entered mean price improvement>=0.10pp and strict30 median MAE nonworse, +3 preservation>=.85. Deep separately descriptive (tiny n cannot certify).

evaluation.baseline: B0_IMMEDIATE exact original scheduled OPEN, independently of optional feature coverage
evaluation.classes: Exact v1 path_class and v2 FAST_WINNER, no altered hindsight classification.
evaluation.economic: Unconditional diagnostic as explicitly requested, even when Entry gate fails. Exact frozen Candidate A, exact Fixed12 fallback cost .05pp. Identical opportunity pairs; no-entry cash0; missing entered outcome UNKNOWN excluded explicitly. Report entered-paired and cash-inclusive separately.
evaluation.risk: baselineEnteredTail-entryTail = BETTER_ENTRY_LOCATION; baselineAllTail-baselineEnteredTail = SKIP_AVOIDANCE (split MODEL_SKIP, cap/boundary/missing expiry). Sum equals total tail-count difference. Also strict30 paired risk.
evaluation.top3: TRAIN all-emitted frequency, descending count/symbol ascending; diagnostic exclusion only, no refit
evaluation.volatility: TRAIN available t0 rangeMean median, fixed before Validation; below/equal/above plus missing panels; no routing use
evaluation.windows: Reuse v2 complete original+60 common end; own-entry strict30 for MAE; report all-emitted and complete denominators, incomplete retained UNKNOWN.

purpose: One first integrated measurement through Validation, including exact Candidate A counterfactual regardless Entry gate. No tuning after TRAIN or Validation; do not freeze candidate. No DEV TEST/Fresh/OOS. Prior v1-v3 failures inform design, not deployment endorsement.

resultClassification.compositeGates: PASS if satisfied else FAIL (no arbitrary near band). Structural WAIT>0 and delayedEnter>0 required.
resultClassification.metricBands: Higher is better. PASS observed>=target. NEAR_MISS observed>=target-nearTolerance. HARD_FAIL observed<hardFloor. Else FAIL. Undefined required observations HARD_FAIL. No near-miss qualification changes pass gates.
resultClassification.overall: Worst status among all main numeric metrics and composite Entry/Economic/structural/integrity gates; integrity failure HARD_FAIL. No performance PASS from tests.

runControl.stop: After report+tests+CI+immutable evidence; even PASS no DEV TEST or freeze.
